Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the call this morning - helpful to walk through Acme's use case and regulatory checklist. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

Summary of ask:
- Acme needs a signed Data Processing Agreement (DPA) and confirmation of which SCC module(s) Redwood should use for cross-border transfers.
- Clarify controller vs processor roles: Acme will act as controller; Redwood will be processor (we confirmed during call).
- SOC 2 status: we are SOC 2 Type II in progress (expected report Q4), already have SOC-related controls in place; offering compensating evidence now if helpful.

What I attached: Redwood_DPA_v3.2.pdf (DPA draft) and SCC-module-mapping.xlsx (recommended modules + rationale).

Proposal / next steps:
1) Please confirm Acme's preferred SCC module(s). Based on your data flows we recommended Module 2 (Processor) + Supplementary Module 3 in the spreadsheet, but open to your legal's preference.
2) If your legal team has redlines, route them back to me and we can loop in Rishi from Legal for any non-standard clauses.
3) We can target an initial DPA turnaround of 5 business days once we receive comments; if Acme requires DocuSign we can send a signing request.
4) I'll follow up on SOC 2 evidence separately (certificates and control narratives).

Suggested times for a quick follow-up with legal (30 min): Tue Sep 22 09:00-11:00 or Wed Sep 23 14:00-16:00 BST.

Thanks - I'll coordinate once you confirm which slot works for Patrick/your legal team.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. A few quick items from our side after reviewing with Patrick and security:

1) Controller/Processor: Confirmed - Acme is controller, Redwood will be processor. We just need that spelled out in the DPA (data categories, purposes, subprocessors list).

2) SCC modules: Our legal prefers the standard Processor-to-Subprocessor flow. Looking at your spreadsheet, Patrick is leaning toward Module 2 (for processors) and the Controller-Processor Addendum. He asked whether Redwood supports the new EU SCCs (2021) modules and, specifically, whether the mapping in SCC-module-mapping.xlsx corresponds to the 2021 templates or an internal equivalence. Can you confirm which version you mapped?

3) SOC 2: Security team asked for any interim control evidence you can share (system inventory, access control policy, encryption at rest/in transit notes). They understand the Type II report is upcoming but want compensating docs for now.

4) Timeline: If you can confirm SCC version and provide the DPA with an annotation for the controller/processor sections, we'll circulate to legal and aim to provide redlines within 3-4 business days.

Patrick/Legal: looped.

Thanks,
Emma
